Sandbox_CookieOnTheWay_PricePerKm_toolti: Fare = road km x this, rounded up to $10. 136 makes Rosewood to Louisville General Hospital = $2,000.
Sandbox_CookieOnTheWay_MinFare_tooltip: No trip costs less than this.
Sandbox_CookieOnTheWay_PassengerPct_tool: Each rider who is not the booker adds this share of the trip fare.
Sandbox_CookieOnTheWay_TrailerFee_toolti: Added once per trip when towing.
Sandbox_CookieOnTheWay_BabySeatDays: Baby seat: under this many days survived
Sandbox_CookieOnTheWay_BabySeatDays_tool: One rider per car under this age rides free when an adult is in the car (not for the booker).
Sandbox_CookieOnTheWay_ZombieSpeed_toolt: Zombies on the road slow the car to this and it pushes through.
Sandbox_CookieOnTheWay_GroupGap_tooltip: Each car keeps at least this far behind the car in front.
Sandbox_CookieOnTheWay_EmergencyFeePct: Stop here fee (% on top of distance)
Sandbox_CookieOnTheWay_EmergencyFeePct_t: Stop here = fare for the distance driven plus this share, never more than the full fare.
Sandbox_CookieOnTheWay_BlockedSeconds: Seconds stopped at an obstacle before the trip ends
Sandbox_CookieOnTheWay_BlockedSeconds_to: The trip then ends and is charged by distance.
Sandbox_CookieOnTheWay_MinFuelPct_toolti: Running dry on the way ends the trip by distance.
Sandbox_CookieOnTheWay_RequireWallet_too: Off: without the wallet mod trips are free. On: autopilot is off until the wallet is there.
